_cal_note: CAL 2026-08-28 ledger: generated by pipeline/stars/caliber_2026-08-28/run_cal_ledger.py, which runs the unedited analysis/paper/ledger_p3afar.py with load_paths() pointed at the caliber universe — estimates from data/cal2026-08-28/estimates/P3lb_{field}_A_far.json, raw rates recomputed from data/cal2026-08-28/frames/p3_afar_{field}.parquet, topic cut from data/cal2026-08-28/frames/p3_afar_counts.csv (all sha-verified against data/cal2026-08-28/MANIFEST.sha256 before the run). speed_bracket is ABSENT: its pairs_slim_cap_* inputs have no builder anywhere (pipeline/NOT_REPRODUCIBLE.md entry 9), so no caliber counterpart exists. null_simulation is ABSENT: B0_null_test.R is not in this repository, so no caliber no-effect simulation exists. The _source_note below is the generator's own text and describes the FROZEN universe it normally runs in; it is kept verbatim because the computation lines it documents are exactly the ones that ran here.
_source_note: Panel 3 (A_far): same-topic roster incumbents outside the star's two-hop network. Estimates from results/out/P3lb_{field}_A_far.json (dCDH, effects=5, placebo=4, pair x event groups; pair- and event-clustered SEs). Raw rates recomputed from data/pairs_slim_lb_{field}_A_far.parquet on observable pair-years (calendar year <= 2024); post window = tau 0..5. Topic cut from data/lb_counts.csv; fitted counterfactuals from data/speed_bracket.csv (log-linear fit of the pre-arrival rate on pair age; cf_flat = fitted level at tau -1, cf_trend = mean fitted level over tau 0..5); no-effect simulation from results/out_null/NULL_{field}_A_far.json. Script: analysis/paper/ledger_p3afar.py (replication-repo port of <manuscript>/scripts/p3_afar_numbers_and_figure.py); pair-year panels, topic cut and speed bracket read from this package's data/frames (byte-identical to the legacy run directory); estimate JSONs read from this package's analysis/expected (the frozen golds), with the legacy copy compared against them when present; no-effect simulations from data/paper_inputs.
